card.name: Drugs that depend on metabolism or pH
card.fires_on: The word "that" (or "where", or "drugs" itself) right after "drugs" or "agents" in interaction text. It sits just before a clause saying how those drugs are metabolized, transported or dissolved.

modes.label: Relative word after drugs
modes.description: "that" or "where" links "drugs" to a clause about enzymes, transporters or pH.
modes.example: Zonisamide is not expected to interfere with the metabolism of other drugs<< that>> are metabolized by cytochrome P

modes.label: The word drugs after effect phrase
modes.description: "drugs" follows "absorption of" or "exposure of" and is followed by a description of how they are handled.
modes.example: SUNLENCA may increase the exposure of<< drugs>> primarily metabolized by CYP3A

card.writes: It promotes words meaning "rely on" or "depend on" and suppresses "permanent", which fits a clause saying the drugs depend on something.
card.plain: It marks the point in an interaction sentence where the text says which other drugs are affected because they depend on a certain enzyme or on stomach acidity.
